title: Sharing service docs: list the tri-state write verdicts and the set form; correct the per-row cost in changeset 35802
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYtTDvfPQDzMbZnN5X

Parent: #36232. Source: the seat's contract review of PR #37558 (card #35934), record 7193294421, section ③. Under the maintainer's rule, small issues go to follow-up cards.

## What is wrong

1. `content/docs/kernel/runtime-services/sharing-service.mdx` lists only `buildReadFilter`, `canEdit`, `canDelete` and `canManageShares`. It never listed the tri-state `checkEdit` / `checkDelete`, and after PR #37558 it also misses the optional set form, `checkEditMany` / `checkDeleteMany`. A plugin author reading the page cannot learn either exists.
2. `.changeset/35802-predicate-write-floor-deferral.md` states a per-row cost for bulk writes. After PR #37558, that is stale for the bundled sharing service: it now takes two reads per 1,000-id chunk. Both changesets ship in the same release, so the release notes would contradict each other.

## Done when

- The page lists `checkEdit` / `checkDelete` (allow / deny / not-applicable) and the optional `checkEditMany` / `checkDeleteMany`, with the fallback to the per-row loop when a service does not implement them.
- The 35802 changeset's cost paragraph is corrected before the next release consumes it, under a deliberate-correction declaration, or a short note in a new changeset supersedes it.

Priority: p2. Item 2 must land before the release that carries both changesets. Domain: docs, server.
